item.title: Pioneers, Continentals earn NCAA Hockey Tournament bids
item.description: One had an automatic bid, one had to sweat it out. However, by the end of Sunday, March 8, both the Utica University Pioneers and the Hamilton Continentals had earned return tickets to the NCAA Division III Ice Hockey Tournament.

item.title: More than 15,000 gather in Albany in support of changes to Tier 6
item.description: More than 15,000 New York state workers rallied at MVP Arena on Sunday, calling on lawmakers to change Tier 6, the pension system for new employees hired after 2012. News10’s Amber Fisher was at the rally and spoke with teachers, firefighters, and other state workers about why they believe Tier 6 isn’t fair.

item.title: UPD searching for info in Mohawk Street stabbing

item.title: NYS home care workers advocate for Medicaid reform
item.description: Home care workers and Democratic State Senator Gustavo Rivera rallied at the New York State Capitol to remove Medicaid long-term care from private insurers and save the state $3 billion a year with the Home Care Savings and Reinvestment Act.

item.title: New York lawmakers aim to bridge food aid gaps with state funds
item.description: Democratic state legislators and anti-hunger advocates rallied at the State Capitol to support including a food security package in the upcoming state budget, which would provide more state protections and funding for nutrition programs and welfare benefits following federal cuts to food access in New York.

item.title: Quiet through Tuesday! Midweek rain, then colder, windy.
item.description: High pressure will keep things quiet and dry through Tuesday! Overnight, skies will stay mostly clear with light winds, which will let temperatures drop efficiently. That setup could lead to some patchy fog in valleys early Tuesday morning, but it should burn off quickly after sunrise. Once the fog clears, Tuesday looks mild and pleasant. [...]
